description: Moldova's National Bureau of Statistics published the final results of the 2024 Population and Housing Census as Romanian language Excel annexes. The occupied dwellings workbook has 37 tables; tables 11.16 to 11.37 go down to every town, village and commune by CUATM statistical code and give, for individual houses, apartment blocks and other units, the cold water supply system, hot water, bath or shower, flush toilet, sewerage connection (central network, own system, other, none), main heating mode with fuel, cooking energy, and air conditioning and renewable energy installations, as counts and shares. A second workbook describes residential buildings by construction period, type, wall and roof material, and apartment blocks by floors, also by locality. Coverage is national for the resident population of 2,409.2 thousand on 8 April 2024: of 995,298 occupied dwellings, 414,978 were connected to a central sewer network and 228,756 had no sewerage. Format and access: free XLSX downloads, no registration; microdata only through an access request under the statistics law. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: Romanian headers only; some urban totals are not whole numbers, which suggests weighting or imputation that the workbook does not explain. Simulation uses: village level shares of dwellings on water, sewer and district heat networks and heating fuels for network and energy planning, and wall material and building age for seismic and flood exposure. Related records: the Georgia census 2024 dwelling facilities tables and the Latvia census dwelling amenities tables.
